quotes.text: Replacing the address book custom search input needed the current term when switching directories. Review rejected copying the old mutable value API merely for drop-in compatibility; the author kept a value getter, removed a placeholder getter that only served tests, and used visible shadow slot text in the test. Current widget has get value, reset, and overrideSearchTerm, with no value setter; address book commands call reset before displaying or editing a contact. Match the widget behavior rather than rebuilding an old input API.
